newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks rise in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened moderately higher on Monday, helped by follow-through buying in bank and construction shares.
But brokers said that the key Nikkei average could hover at around 19,000, as major blue-chip issues are likely to be pressured by profit-taking.
The Nikkei 225 average rose 106.91 points or 0.56 percent to 19,141.45 in the first 10 minutes of trade. Its March futures were 90 points higher at 19,120.
